chandogya_chapter1_verse3.title: Chandogya Chapter 1 Verse 3
chandogya_chapter1_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Chandogya, Chapter 1.
chandogya_chapter1_verse3.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Chandogya Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 3, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
chandogya_chapter1_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
